# Version 3.0.0
> **Modernized preview release** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.0.0-preview.5.4)

> **Superseded by [3.116.0](3.116.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 3.116.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.0.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.0.0 preview modernizes the bindings, graphics engine, and supported .NET platforms. It introduces current .NET tooling, updated Skia and HarfBuzz dependencies, accelerated views, and a broad API cleanup. This preview contains breaking API changes; review the migration guidance before adopting it.

## Breaking Changes

- **Previously obsolete APIs were removed** — APIs that had been marked obsolete were removed from the managed surface. Update callers to their documented replacements and rebuild against the new API-diff report. ([#2539](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2539))
- **Platform view APIs were realigned** — Several platform-specific view and graphics APIs changed as the supported target frameworks were modernized. Update platform project references and adjust code to the current view APIs. ([#2505](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2505), [#2788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2788))

## Engine

- **Updated Skia and native dependencies** — Moves the bundled renderer to Skia m116 and refreshes HarfBuzz, WebP, and JPEG support for the modernized release line. ([#2829](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2829), [#2624](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2624), [#2582](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2582), [#2622](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2622), [#2583](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2583))

## API Surface

- **New drawing and data APIs** — Adds SKBlender, SKImage.ToRawShader, SKPicture recording APIs, and span-based overloads for color filters and rounded rectangles. — ❤️ [@Youssef1313](https://github.com/Youssef1313) ([#2830](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2830), [#2748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2748), [#2883](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2883), [#2879](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2879), [#2949](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2949))
- **Accelerated and web view support expanded** — Adds GL views for desktop platforms and accelerated WinUI views, while Blazor components can now respect display density. — ❤️ [@beto-rodriguez](https://github.com/beto-rodriguez), [@gmurray81](https://github.com/gmurray81) ([#2598](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2598), [#2733](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2733), [#1832](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/1832), [#2317](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2317))

## Bug Fixes

- **Platform rendering and disposal corrected** — Fixes Metal snapshots, Uno canvas pixel format and activation, MAUI view lifetime handling, and cloned SKPaint disposal. — ❤️ [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast), [@Youssef1313](https://github.com/Youssef1313), [@jeromelaban](https://github.com/jeromelaban), [@jeremy-visionaid](https://github.com/jeremy-visionaid) ([#2804](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2804), [#2918](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2918), [#2559](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2559), [#2955](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2955), [#2904](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2904))

## Platform

- **Modern .NET and Apple platform support** — Updates projects to .NET 8 and enables Metal rendering on Mac Catalyst with shared Metal API target frameworks. — ❤️ [@maxkatz6](https://github.com/maxkatz6) ([#2927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2927), [#2747](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2747), [#2788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2788))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz stack and modernizes its interop bindings alongside the SkiaSharp 3.0 platform transition.
